invocation.description: Free-form by design (additionalProperties intentionally left open) — the three properties below document a convention, not a restriction. entrypoint already existed in practice before this schema described it; orb_version/orb_runtime_hash are new, optional pinning fields.

entrypoint.description: Dotted callable path the Pod resolves dynamically (e.g. via importlib), e.g. "core.rls.engine.RecursiveLearningEngine.execute_session".

orb_version.description: The exact Orb release this Umbilical expects, e.g. "1.0.0". Optional pin — absent means no version gate is enforced at attachment time.

orb_runtime_hash.description: SHA-256 (uppercase hex) of the Orb's exact source bytes this Umbilical expects, using the same hash convention as the Orb's own per-invocation evidence ledger. Optional pre-invocation gate distinct from that evidence, which is recorded after the fact.
